runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 09:20 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress Jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, public Facebook indexing, and broader public-web corroboration. No new offer met both fit and evidence threshold for safe LIVE promotion. DHL Express IT end-user support is fresh and BA-local but active English plus on-call duty are substantial penalties. Porsche IT Sales & After Sales is canonical and fresh but B2 English plus 3 years project/release-management experience is a strong mismatch. Upwork WooCommerce results were either stale/low-paid/high-competition. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

sources.name: Profesia
sources.note: Fresh BA/remote searches were executed; no new full-detail candidate strong enough for promotion in this pass.

sources.name: Direct company careers
sources.note: Volkswagen Group/Porsche canonical career detail verified IT Sales & After Sales Specialist, Bratislava, published 14 Sep 2026; excluded from promotion because English B2 and 3 years IT project/release-management experience are explicit.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.note: Fresh BA support discovery included DHL Express IT podpora koncových užívateľov and CoolPeople IT Support Specialist. DHL: 2,000–2,200 EUR + up to 10%, BA, but active English and rotating on-call. CoolPeople: excellent English explicitly required. Both penalized below promotion threshold.

sources.name: Upwork

Best operational fit was WooCommerce Product Listing & Upload Specialist at 10–30 USD/h, but it is ~3 weeks old, already has 20–50 proposals, 1 hire and 4 interviews. Other hits were low-paid, stale, or required stronger development/English. No promotion.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Availability-friction score
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Add a data-layer penalty for on-call, weekends, night shifts and wide rotating windows separately from skill fit, so technically good jobs do not outrank sustainable schedules.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Candidate decay by market activity
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: For freelance jobs, decay priority using age + proposals + hires + interviews + client-last-viewed instead of age alone; automatically suppress opportunities where the hiring window is effectively closing.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No write to jobs-data was attempted without a guaranteed complete round-trip.
